write.description: Ancient, divided city in the empire of Vaenyr, with slate rooftops and the Black Spires. It rains often, and bells toll for funerals or warnings. It is the seat of the Ascendant Circle and of House Velaris.
relationships: The Bleak Wards police its magic and trade, while Sartha works through shadow and subversion

write.description: Shae's domain in Mourhold: a tiered social sanctum of silk banners and violet lamplight, with the Velvet Parlors, the Hall of Echoes, the Obsidian Baths and the Binding Parlor. Patrons are ranked by tier, Obsidian being the highest.
relationships: Its master is [[Elara Velaris]], Shae's distant cousin and betrothed (not her sister)
Stands in [[Mourhold]]
The Veiled Vigil, the Circle's high sanctum, lies beneath it: walls of books bound in flesh and iron, an obsidian table, and an altar of Elyndra where Eira prays

write.description: A reincarnating fellowship of divine champions, led by Shae, who remembers their past lives first. Members: Elara Velaris, Rhylla Greysong, Galen Orinel, Eira the Silent, Koryth Mal'Nereth and Calyth Neran.
relationships: Meets in the Veiled Vigil beneath [[The Shade's Refuge]]
Based in [[Mourhold]]
Led by [[Shaedryn Velaris]]; [[Elara Velaris]] and [[Rhylla Greysong]] are her companions in it
Shae's stated plan: strengthen House Velaris, take control of trade, then move out from under the Bleak Wards' shadow

write.description: Vyrkani enforcer and Shae's quiet shield. He speaks rarely, prefers action, would die for Shae, and watches everyone else with suspicion. In a dreamlike fugue he once called her 'The Firebrand'.
relationships: Member of the [[Ascendant Circle]]
In a vision of a past life he lifted a burning banner and Shae died in his arms

write.description: Exiled priestess and warlock, the most spiritually attuned of the Circle. She kneels at the altar of Elyndra, collects and translates forgotten tongues, and has said in trance: 'Vel'asha Miren Tal. The Cycle, Returned.'
relationships: Member of the [[Ascendant Circle]]
Her bond with Shae is mystical and devout, not romantic; she believes Shae is touched by divinity

write.description: Youngest and newest Circle member, a young honourable paladin who bears the Shard of Aurenis. He was declared Champion of Valthir at the Broken Bastion, with Crimson Wardens present. He is still unsure whether Shae is a chosen leader or a tyrant.
relationships: Member of the [[Ascendant Circle]]
Travels and scouts with Calyth Neran, his companion

write.description: Ranger and Koryth's companion: practical, balanced, with a past in the shadows and the wilds. She proposed hiring a disgraced war band east of the Blackward Coast that fought in the War of Unraveling.
relationships: Member of the [[Ascendant Circle]]
Companion of [[Koryth Mal'Nereth]]

write.description: Noblewoman, cool-headed strategist and political ally of the Circle, involved in trade reform. Her bond with Shae is strategic and kept professional.
relationships: Close ally of the [[Ascendant Circle]], not a member
[[Elara Velaris]] and [[Rhylla Greysong]] both distrust her, seeing her as competition for Shae's attention

other_names: Old Goddess of Shadows and Sacrifice
write.description: The Old Goddess of Shadows, Sacrifice and Survival. [[Shaedryn Velaris]] is her champion and bears the Shard of Sartha. She has warned Shae 'The gods lie' and now stresses adaptation over dogma.
relationships: Her powers for Shae include Shadowstep, Veil of Sartha and Echo of Sacrifice, at a cost in health and exposure to divine detection
Patron of the leader of the [[Ascendant Circle]]

write.description: Whispered myth that the gods were once a single being, and that the Gods' Stone is the origin of the divine fracture. Goal if taken up: find the other shards and learn the truth behind the gods. Clues so far: Shae holds Sartha's shard, Koryth holds Aurenis's, others are hidden; Eira has found fragments; Sartha says the gods lie. Not yet pursued.
relationships: [[Eira the Silent]] has uncovered fragments suggesting the gods were once one being
Raised by [[Sartha]]'s warning that the gods lie

write.description: Goddess of Ambition, Desire and Social Ascension; symbols a gilded flame or golden serpent; her creed is 'To rise is to live. To settle is to perish.' She is followed by merchants, nobles and politicians, and is not Shae's patron.
relationships: Elara, Lady Celeste and House Durn lean on her ideals
[[Sartha]] sometimes works with her when ambition serves survival, but distrusts unchecked ambition

write.description: Goddess of secrets, served by the Order of the Silent Veil. Her altar stands in the Veiled Vigil, where Eira prays.
relationships: Her order keeps secrets for information brokers across [[Mourhold]]

write.description: God of Order and control, worshipped with Kaelorith and Tyranna by the Bleak Wards and the Covenant of Lir.
relationships: Opposed in doctrine to [[Sartha]]

write.description: Supreme leader of the Bleak Wards, master of mind magic and illusion. He wants to suppress divine interference and shard power.
relationships: Serves [[Lir]]

write.description: Arcane order that polices magic and knowledge in Mourhold for Lir. It claims arcane security jurisdiction at the eastern docks and delays Lady Celeste's caravans with 'ritual inspections'. Reeling from recent setbacks but tightening its grip.
relationships: Led by [[Archon Varyn Morthal]]
Operates in [[Mourhold]]
Worship [[Lir]]

write.description: Bleak Wards enforcer and military commander, brutally disciplined.
relationships: Serves [[Archon Varyn Morthal]] in the [[Bleak Wards]]

write.description: Bleak Wards mage-hunter and archivist who can detect and suppress forbidden magic. Cold and unyielding.
relationships: Serves [[Archon Varyn Morthal]] in the [[Bleak Wards]]

write.description: Executioner-judge of the Bleak Wards who wields a sacred hammer and sees mercy as rebellion.
relationships: Serves [[Archon Varyn Morthal]] in the [[Bleak Wards]]

write.description: Rumour that the Bleak Wards are developing rituals against shard bearers and calling in divine enforcers, possibly aimed at the Circle's families, resources or allies. Goal if taken up: learn what the rituals are and strike first. Clues so far: Veyra Nox's coded message said 'The next shard pulses beneath us' and 'Red breath moves in the lower wards'. Not yet investigated.
relationships: Attributed to the [[Bleak Wards]] under [[Archon Varyn Morthal]]

write.description: Church faction of Lir that has declared Shae a false prophet and rallies Mourhold's traditionalists. Led by Duke Elias Corvan with Lady Ivette Ravenhall, it is gathering the old noble guard for a Covenant gathering.
relationships: Worship [[Lir]]
Likely to ally with the [[Bleak Wards]]; a reckoning with it is expected

write.description: Head of the Covenant of Lir; a traditionalist who advocates rigid hierarchy and divine order. His embargoes hurt Lady Bellum's trade.
relationships: Leads the [[Covenant of Lir]]
Rallies traditionalists in [[Mourhold]] against the Circle

write.description: Noble house of Mourhold, once ruled by Maelis. Colours are deep charcoal, slate blue and threadbare crimson; the crest is a broken crown with a downward-pointing dagger. Shae is now its de facto head.
relationships: Seated at the Veiled Manor, in [[Mourhold]]
Allied with the [[Ascendant Circle]] under Shae

write.description: The Velaris family seat, where Shae confronted her mother, held a pivotal family gathering, and held the oath ritual at a shrine of Sartha.
relationships: Seat of [[House Velaris]]

write.description: Shae's mother and former matriarch of House Velaris: regal, ice-eyed, cold and politically ruthless. She exiled Shae and allied with the Bleak Wards, then swore an oath to Shae at the Veiled Manor and reconciled. Her loyalty is sworn but proud and conditional.
relationships: Mother of [[Shaedryn Velaris]]
Led [[House Velaris]] until Shae took over
Allied with the [[Bleak Wards]] before Shae's return

write.create: The oath at the Veiled Manor
write.description: At the Veiled Manor, after Shae's invocation to Sartha ('take Lady Maelis into the shadows, bind her as you bind me') and a broken marionette cutting the strings of the past, Shae offered her hand: 'Join us, and House Velaris will rise like no other has in a thousand years. Fight us, and you'll scatter like dust on the wind.' Maelis took it and swore: 'Then let the shadows take me too. For House Velaris.' Shae corrected: 'For us.'
relationships: Sworn by [[Maelis Velaris]] to [[Shaedryn Velaris]] and, through her, to [[Sartha]]
Followed by a tearful reconciliation: Shae dropped to her knees, held Maelis's legs and said 'I forgive you'; Maelis, shaken, answered 'Shaedryn... my daughter'
Shae then joked to Elara 'Have you noticed how beautiful my mother is?' and Maelis laughed, 'You always did know how to ruin a moment, Shaedryn'
Took place at the [[Veiled Manor]]; [[Elara Velaris]] was present

write.description: Velaris kinsman executed in Shae's purges. A spy, Harlon, served his schemes before Shae gave him mercy and put him under Soraya's care.
relationships: Dead; his fall helped reshape the family's view of Shae as protector
Belonged to [[House Velaris]]

write.description: Velaris traitor Shae says she saved the family from. Dead.
relationships: Belonged to [[House Velaris]]
Shae cited this and the purge of traitors to Evander Velaris as her claim to the heirship

write.description: Elder of House Velaris, the Warden of Secrets: keeper of the family's ancient library, robed in old black, adviser to Archon Morthal. At a gala Shae embraced him in public; he stayed guarded but no longer opposes her openly.
relationships: Warden of secrets for [[House Velaris]]
Advises [[Archon Varyn Morthal]] and attends Bleak Wards councils
Loyal to [[Maelis Velaris]] but beginning to question her strength
Said to Shae at the gala: 'You've always had a way of redefining expectations, Shaedryn. I suppose I shouldn't be surprised.'

write.description: Shae's cousin of the same generation and the Velaris representative in the High Court: cool, calculating, a diplomat who prizes stability. Unmarried. He long served Maelis; Shae's argument at the Veiled Manor won him over, and he now supports her but watches closely.
relationships: Represents [[House Velaris]] in the High Court
Won over at the [[Veiled Manor]] by Shae's words about Darius and the purge
Warned Shae to temper power with unity or risk fracturing the family

write.description: Quiet observer and minor socialite of House Velaris, once cautious and now a steady ally of Shae. She approved of the purges after Therrin's fall.
relationships: Close ally of Shae, with Jared Velaris
Belongs to [[House Velaris]]

write.description: Charismatic mediator and skilled negotiator of House Velaris, openly pro-Shae and a swing vote in the family council.
relationships: Close ally of Shae, with [[Tayla Velaris]]
Belongs to [[House Velaris]]
Helped reshape Shae's image from exile to protector after [[Therrin Velaris]]'s execution

write.description: Goal: finish securing House Velaris by winning over or removing Elder Thamiel and keeping Evander aligned. Clues so far: Thamiel softened after the gala embrace but advises the Bleak Wards; Evander agreed to support Shae at the Veiled Manor; Tayla and Jared are allies; Maelis is oath-bound.
relationships: Obstacle: [[Thamiel Velaris]]
Needs steady support from [[Evander Velaris]], [[Tayla Velaris]] and [[Jared Velaris]]
Maelis's oath: [[The oath at the Veiled Manor]]

write.description: The former Graycloaks, remade by Shae into the Circle's elite intelligence and enforcement network. They follow a code of discipline and subtle manipulation, with no senseless violence. They carry Shae's letters by courier.
relationships: Based at the Shade's Vigil, a fortified base near [[The Shade's Refuge]]
Serve the [[Ascendant Circle]]; Rhylla is their spymaster link to Shae
Overseen by Lirian

write.description: Overseer of the Shadowcloaks, pragmatic and efficient.
relationships: Leads the [[Shadowcloaks]]

write.description: Rogue and former city guard, mentor and enforcer of the Shadowcloaks, who upholds loyalty and discipline. She wears worn leather over soft armour and salutes with a fist to the chest.
relationships: Recruited Jarek and carries Shae's messages
Serves in the [[Shadowcloaks]]
Cared for Harlon, once a spy of [[Therrin Velaris]]

write.description: Former city guard recruited by Soraya, steadfast and tactical, now protector of Elara.
relationships: Recruited by [[Soraya Windstride]] into the [[Shadowcloaks]]
Guards [[Elara Velaris]]

write.description: Paranoid leader of the criminal Graycloaks. He betrayed Shae in a failed assassination plot and the Circle killed him in a swift ambush. Dead.
relationships: His syndicate became the [[Shadowcloaks]] under Lirian

write.description: Charismatic, ambitious trader and Obsidian patron of the Refuge, quick to laugh and fond of wine. Her trade routes are blocked by the Bleak Wards and Corvan's embargoes, and she follows Valencia's ideals. She is a close ally of Shae.
relationships: Wants three blocked caravans a tenday released at the eastern docks; the [[Bleak Wards]] stand in the way
Patron of [[The Shade's Refuge]]
Follows [[Valencia]]'s ideals of ambition
Her routes are also squeezed by the Bleak Wards' dock inspections

write.description: Wealthy, cautious aristocrat, widow of a merchant lord, with a chalcedony fan, living at Silverhaven. Her alliance with Shae is formal and sealed by oath; the bond is close and trusting but NOT romantic. Two of her agents vanished last month.
relationships: Allied with Shae in a magical oath in the Binding Parlor of [[The Shade's Refuge]]
Wants security and discretion, quiet results with no blood on her floor
Her trade is hurt by the embargoes of [[Duke Elias Corvan]]
The bond with Shae was deepened at the Obsidian Baths; it is close and personal but not romantic

write.description: After visiting the Refuge in magical disguises (Shae tall with flowing blonde hair and a red gown, Bellum cloaked and masked), Shae and Bellum sealed an alliance in the Binding Parlor. Bellum: 'I, Lady Bellum, stand with Lady Shaedryn Velaris. Our paths entwined, our purposes aligned, so long as this bond holds true.' Shae: 'I, Lady Shaedryn Velaris, stand with Lady Bellum. Our paths entwined, our purposes aligned, so long as we stand together. Should those paths diverge, we walk free.'
relationships: Made between [[Bellum Avarelle]] and [[Shaedryn Velaris]] at [[The Shade's Refuge]]
In the Hall of Echoes the panels showed Shae a crown of shadows and linked hands, and Bellum a glass mask and thorned vines
Afterwards they talked in the Obsidian Baths; the bond is personal, not romantic

write.description: Underworld organisation that once served the Nameless Shadow before turning rogue. It is splintering: some members trust the Bleak Wards to protect their routes, others want to burn the structure down.
relationships: Veyra Nox left it
Shae promised aid to Veyra if the Pale or the Bleak Wards move against her

write.description: Smuggler, about 34, the most capable in Mourhold, and a FORMER member of the Pale. She now is an informal ally of Shae and Obsidian-tier patron of the Refuge. She dresses in understated silks, is dry, playful on her own terms, and sends coded messages.
relationships: Is not part of the Sable Syndicate
Left [[The Pale]] and is now an informal ally of [[Shaedryn Velaris]]
Provides intel, logistics and black-market access, but keeps away from direct warfare
Patron of [[The Shade's Refuge]]; offered an artifact and a secret as tokens of loyalty

write.description: Black-market traders and artifact smugglers dealing in forbidden goods. They encroach on Circle-aligned territories like the Shade's Quarters. Led by Silas Crowley.
relationships: Dangerous if provoked
Encroaches on Circle-aligned territory in [[Mourhold]]

write.description: Leader of the Sable Syndicate: early 50s, tall (over six feet), lean, pale, with melted-silver eyes, black hair streaked silver, and a dust-coloured leather long coat with subtle Syndicate sigils. Low, dry, smooth voice; sometimes an asset, often a liability.
relationships: Leads the [[Sable Syndicate]]
Not the same faction as [[Veyra Nox]], who is a former Pale smuggler

write.description: Rumour that Veyra Nox is working with one of the Pale Remnants, a group that served the Nameless Shadow before turning rogue. Goal if taken up: learn whether she is a loyal ally or a future rival. Clues so far: Veyra stays out of the Pale's infighting, her messages are coded, and she says her loyalty lies with whoever does not make promises they cannot keep. Not yet investigated.
relationships: Concerns [[Veyra Nox]] and [[The Pale]]

write.description: Hall of Mourhold's Merchant Guild, with gold chandeliers, vaulted glasswork and marble floors. It hosts the Merchant Conclave.
relationships: Stands in [[Mourhold]]

write.description: Guildmaster of the Merchant Guild, a pragmatist who oversees shipping permits and licences. He tolerated the Bleak Wards' oversight for security, once allied with Maelis, and resents the Circle's rise.
relationships: Heads the guild that meets in [[The Merchant Guildhall]]
Opposes Shae and expected to vote against her at the Conclave
Once allied with [[Maelis Velaris]]; that foundation has shifted

write.description: High priestess of Valencia's ambition and a cunning political rival of Shae. She may try to block the Circle's influence and may attend the Conclave.
relationships: Follows [[Valencia]]
Cousin of Halran Vos
Shae may have to neutralise her

write.description: Lord of House Vos, mid-fifties, lean and nervous in garnet and gold with a signet ring; an old-money traditionalist who values appearances and holds the swing vote on dock access. He is a laundering partner of the Bleak Wards. His daughter Ilaen, recently married into House Quor, is tied to a scandal of a missing dowry and illicit enchantments in wedding gifts.
relationships: Cousin of [[Liraine Vos]]
Would not oppose the [[Bleak Wards]] unless forced; might abstain if it protects his name
Not yet approached by Shae; Rhylla has offered to find leverage

write.description: Lord of a neutral minor house who holds the rotating seat at the Conclave vote. He nearly always follows the prevailing majority.
relationships: Seats at the Conclave in [[The Merchant Guildhall]]

write.description: Head of the Arcane Bazaar, in her early to mid 40s, statuesque, with near-black hair in a coiled crown, pale grey eyes, porcelain skin and layered dusk-violet robes. Charisma 18; ties to the Bleak Wards; stance ambiguous. Shae has never met her.
relationships: Leads the Arcane Bazaar, with commercial ties to the [[Bleak Wards]]
Possible target for negotiation or subversion

write.description: Upcoming high-sun meeting at the Merchant Guildhall voting on the Eastern Docks Access Act, which would strip the Bleak Wards of dock inspections. Five seats decide it: Vehris (against), Celeste and Bellum (for), Halran Vos (swing), Hareth Dorne (rotating, follows the majority).
relationships: Held in [[The Merchant Guildhall]]
Against: [[Tolan Vehris]]; for: [[Celeste]] and [[Bellum Avarelle]]
Swing votes: [[Halran Vos]] and [[Hareth Dorne]]
Liraine Vos of the Valencia faction may attend: [[Liraine Vos]]

write.create: Open the eastern docks for Celeste
write.description: Goal: end the Bleak Wards' 'ritual inspection' blockade of the eastern docks so Celeste's caravans pass, which will let her reopen the silver lines with Shae's name on every crate. Clues so far: the Conclave vote would transfer inspection to a merchant commission, and Halran Vos holds the swing vote.
relationships: For [[Celeste]]
Obstacles: [[Bleak Wards]] and [[Tolan Vehris]]
Decided by the [[Merchant Conclave vote]]

write.description: Noble house of military strength and rigid tradition, aligned with the Bleak Wards and Lir. Lord Garric Rathven is head, Lady Selyne Rathven his sister, Edric Rathven his nephew who doubts the family's direction.
relationships: Aligned with the [[Bleak Wards]] and [[Lir]]
House Travan, a mercenary house, has grievances against it

write.description: Daughter of Lord Garric Rathven: impulsive scout and information gatherer who acts without her father's approval. About her late forties, with silver-blonde hair streaked grey braided with obsidian, glacial blue eyes, and black and violet robes. Shae has not met her.
relationships: Daughter of Garric of [[House Rathven]]; a possible weak link in her house
Might be won over by Shae

write.description: Cautious merchant nobility, worshipping Valencia and Kaelorith, who hedge their bets until power shifts. Lord Corvin Durn is head, with Lady Isolde and his daughter Ranna. Rivals of Vehris, and may become kingmakers.
relationships: Follow [[Valencia]]
Watching the Circle's rise before choosing a side

write.description: Daughter of Lord Corvin Durn of House Durn (the name is Ranna, not Renna). Mid 30s, human, tall with a whipcord build, black hair in a double-crown braid, dark hazel eyes, olive skin, and slate and gunmetal gowns. Charisma 16; the real strategist behind Durn's trade consolidation.
relationships: Of [[House Durn]]; not part of the Sable Syndicate
Courted by Shae through economic incentives
More influential than her father, though undeclared

write.description: Rumour of an ambitious man named Gregor trying to use the Circle for his own gain, watched by a Circle informant, Evard. Goal if taken up: find what he wants and whether he is acting for someone. Clues: only that he is being watched. Not yet looked into.
relationships: Watched for the [[Ascendant Circle]]

write.description: A rare ceremony of the Order of the Silent Veil marking Elyndra's eclipse, led by High Seeress Lyra Fellwind with Brother Ithran, said to blur truth and secrecy. Goal if taken up: gain favour with Elyndra's followers or learn divine secrets. Clues: none beyond the date. Not yet decided.
relationships: Honours [[Elyndra]]

write.add_to_description: Shae sent Bellum and Celeste letters asking them to attend; she does not sign political letters as Champion of Sartha, only as Shaedryn Velaris of House Velaris and the Shade's Refuge, or as Shae.

add_relationships: For the Conclave, Rhylla has embedded Shadowcloaks as scribes, guards and servants in the [[The Merchant Guildhall]]; Soraya will watch from the rafters and Lirian walks with the outer guard under false colours

write.add_to_description: For the Conclave, Shae wears House Velaris battle regalia of charcoal, slate blue and threadbare crimson: a high-collared duster with the crest, matte-black shadow-woven leather, a single obsidian-runed pauldron, a knife from Rhylla and Elara's ring-blade in her boot.

add_relationships: Would also give Shae reach into the West Guild, the linen houses and Lord Rellan, if she gets security
